items.title: Replay-safe event and occurrence identity
items.acceptance: One duplicated completion cannot finish another occurrence; conflicting payloads cannot silently replace an earlier event.
items.note: Conflicts now withhold credit (R01); occurrence bound at start.

items.title: Daytime interval scheduling and ranged repetitions
items.acceptance: Respect the approved waking window, interval anchor and repetition range; no immediate next-round invitation or accumulated catch-up dose.
items.note: Schedule in version/confirmation (R02); time-aware UI (R03); blank-field editor; no clinical values; C05 open.

items.title: Bind clinical programmes to approved source revisions
items.acceptance: Trace each operative restriction and exercise instruction to an approved revision; preserve amendments and explicit unresolved fields.

items.title: Exact exercise variants and conditional precautions
items.acceptance: Posture, assistance, loading, brace state and associated procedure affect assignment; unsupported measurement does not erase a clinical restriction.

items.title: Learn, Do and Check
items.acceptance: Watching is not activity; activity is not automatically an assessment; only qualified compatible observations enter the assessment series.

items.title: Approved reference-video journey
items.acceptance: Exercise-matched asset plays, enlarges, pauses and recovers from network failure; wrong assets do not silently substitute.

items.title: Native, enlarged-text and older-user usability
items.acceptance: Record real device and assisted/unassisted workflow results; browser fixtures and axe results alone are insufficient.

items.title: Clean test-runner shutdown
items.acceptance: The selected tests finish without forced exit or leaking timers; preserve actual exit status.
items.note: Independent Mac parallel and detectOpenHandles runs are recorded; integration must preserve this. No blanket approval of other changes.

items.title: Resolve source-version and terminology questions
items.acceptance: Owner resolves the approval register without the agent averaging or guessing conflicting source instructions.

items.title: Measurement repeatability and cohort evidence
items.acceptance: Separate synthetic tests from independent reference measurement, repeatability and supervised clinical usability evidence.

items.title: Authenticated clinical authorization and patient-data governance
items.acceptance: A setup toggle is not clinician identity; establish actual access control, consent, retention and authorized data delivery before clinical deployment.
items.note: Local programme origin, disputed-record correction authority, profile isolation and privacy remain G02/G03/G04/G10. Remote clinician identity/portal/monitoring are deferred, not MVP prerequisites.

items.title: Portable strict native dependency installation
items.acceptance: Fresh local/hosted installation uses the agreed toolchain, preserves lock, passes build and selected native tests; no deployment/pipefail bypass.
items.review_note: Claude independently corroborated native toolchain and hosted result at 707a6e7, supplied by owner; does not review later storage changes or accept whole G01.

items.title: Encrypted-storage read error must not overwrite history
items.acceptance: Existing bytes survive rejected reads, retries and subsequent app updates; explicit error/recovery state before migration.

items.title: Patient-only copy without invented clinician relationship
items.acceptance: Independent patient is not promised monitoring or trapped waiting for an unconnected clinician; restrictions remain enforced.

scope: iPhone patient-only local-first; clinician/surgeon platform deferred
